route: Frankfurt → Central European Branch Office → Munich
intro: The final major travel day in Germany begins in Frankfurt and heads first to Selters for a visit to the Central European Branch Office. From there, the journey continues south finishing the day in Munich for the final nights of The Long Way Around.
